item.title: China Puts Quantum Technology Among Priorities in New 2030 Cyber Industry Plan
item.summary: Insider Brief China has identified quantum technology as one of a group of frontier fields targeted for development under a new five-year plan aimed at strengthening the country’s cybersecurity and information technology companies. According to The China Daily, the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission released the action plan Friday, laying out priorities for China’s cyberspace industry […]
